_aide: Help (the field names stay in French, the page reads them): file edited by hand. Dates as YYYY-MM-DD. echeances (deadlines): WARN when alerte_jours days or fewer are left, CRIT at 7 days or fewer and once passed. restaurations (restore tests): put today's date in dernier_test after each successful test; WARN if never tested (null) or if the last test is older than max_jours. nom = name, comment = how to do the test.

echeances.action: Cloudflare, Domain Registration, Manage Domains, example.com: check that Auto-Renew is on and the payment card is valid (otherwise renew by hand).
pfSense, System, Cert. Manager, Certificates: renew the GUI certificate (Renew), then check System, Advanced, Admin Access.
The certificate is managed by UniFi OS: update UniFi OS or restart the console, then read the date again.

restaurations.comment: DSM, Hyper Backup, task Synology Share Folder, Backup Explorer: pick a file, then Copy to (or Download) to get it elsewhere without touching the original; open it to check, then delete the copy. The Restore button replaces the file at its original location.
DSM, Active Backup for Business, File Server, Backup-Dashboard, Restore: restore index.html to a test folder and compare with the original.
Proxmox, backup storage, Backups: pick a backup of a small CT, Restore with a new ID (e.g. 999) and Unique checked, start it without network, check, then delete CT 999.
